environment.serving: individual gzip level9 resources over localhost HTTP, fresh browser profile each sample

limitations: Single desktop browser/host, localhost network and OS filesystem caches; no mobile/browser fleet inference
Fresh processes/profiles reset browser code/data cache; host disk caches may remain warm
JS heap samples omit unmeasured Wasm linear memory, native browser allocations and between-sample peaks
Warm sample distributions include timer resolution and host scheduling; per-browser summaries retain clustering

memory.scope: Chrome performance.memory samples during preparation and after conversions and final CDP metrics; not process RSS or Wasm linear-memory peak

protocol.startup: navigation time origin to prepared converter plus verified first conversion; benchmark warmups excluded
protocol.timing: performance.now surrounds conversion only; full native-output equality and heap sampling outside intervals
